exposure: blastocyst hatching status (non-hatching, hatching, completely hatched, early hatching, mid-hatching, late hatching)
cohort: The participants were patients undergoing 817 single vitrified-warmed blastocyst transfer (SVBT) cycles between January 2016 and December 2017.
finding: Advanced blastocyst hatching status is positively associated with higher rates of implantation, clinical pregnancy, and live birth, without negatively influencing neonatal outcomes.
